metadata.scenario_context: Adam has won a scholarship to study at a prestigious university. His friends plan to hold a celebration party in his honor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly

Making our parents proud is something I believe many of us strive for, because at the end of the day, we all want to feel connected and appreciated. It’s just a matter of how we show it.
